verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a SaaS service that processes merchant and customer transaction data, so whether it offers an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-usage policies, AI training, or an opt-out mechanism. The docs cover tax calculation, registration, filing and reports, and the probes cover llms.txt, MCP and CLI tooling, none of which address this story.
